The '''mongworst''' was a small, deadly [[Insect/Legends|insect]] native to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] bred these creatures for [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] fights and executions in the [[Petranaki arena]].
